notes.title: Major update: New title and new controls!
notes.content:
[b]We're happy to announce some fresh news for the game! We just published an update with 2 important changes.[/b]

First, you probably noticed already but we decided to change the very title of the game. It can seem a bit strange to change a title long after a release, but we realized some players were confused about the 'Another' in the title and were wondering if it was an actual sequel. We also decided to choose for a more simple name to improve the discoverability and search over the various stores... rumble rumble... so we decided to go for "A Fisherman's Tale 2"!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682204/90b76ab3bd167332992827e3a1ba31ed203a0407.png[/img]

The other major update is on the controls of the game. Since the release, we realized controls we had initially offered could be frustrating and/or confusing. Even if we wanted to have something that felt more 'VR', we realized the feeling wasn't really there and it was lacking maneuverability, which is very important in some parts of the game. To find ways to improve this - again after release and without changing the gameplay - was not an easy task and striking the right complexity/feel/maneuverability balance either. So we took into account many feedback from the users and fused them into a new approach of the control scheme. Now, it's more based on a classic 'third person control' of the Joystick to move around Bob's hand and body. That said, to achieve this new scheme, we had to make some compromises: it's still a bit challenging to learn, but it feels much better and you have much more control, so we feel it's really worth it. We hope you as well! :)

[b]Patch notes in a nutshell: [/b]
[list]
[*] Title change in all contexts of the game.
[*] Controls scheme is completely revamped with fitting tutorial panels.
[/list]

We are looking forward to hearing your feedback about this update and we hope you'll enjoy our game even more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682204/0f5fc06068704c059917f5a655d9fe4f6c28494f.png[/img]

notes.title: 🩸 The 7th Guest VR is OUT NOW! 🩸
notes.content:
[h2]THE GATES TO STAUF MANSION FINALLY RE-OPEN[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2456960/The_7th_Guest_VR/

On the 30th year anniversary of the original tale, The 7th Guest VR launches on PC VR, Playstation VR2 and Meta Quest 2 & 3. Plus, upgraded graphics for the newly released Quest 3 will be coming in by Halloween!

[h2]REVIEWS[/h2]

[i]“One of the Best VR Games I Experienced in 2023.”[/i]
- Gamertag VR

[i]“An Ingenious Reimagining.”[/i]
- Digital Trends

[i]“A Potentially Groundbreaking Title for VR Gaming.”[/i]
- Screenrant


[previewyoutube=jsuDYswhtaE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]THE STORY[/h2]

The iconic mystery game that chilled you to the bone in the 90s, the 7th Guest, has been brought back to life with cutting-edge VR technology that delivers an atmospheric and haunting story.

Six guests have been welcomed to the foreboding mansion. But something sinister is at play…

Explore Stauf Mansion, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest VR is the ultimate mystery adventure, and it’s time for you to experience it for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192446/dd3959323118762469d76ecb8bef111dbbac42df.jpg[/img]


[h2]WHAT YOU'LL EXPERIENCE[/h2]

[h3]A Technical Benchmark:[/h3]

Immerse into a visceral & haunting VR story. Told through innovative and cutting-edge ghostly volumetric video capture with 3D live-action graphics and exquisite performances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192446/344ea2bd38e77e5f0ff20929e3e32d20deade36c.jpg[/img]

[h3]A Beloved Classical Brand:[/h3]

Experience the classic game by Trilobyte and relive the original story from a whole new perspective. The 7th Guest VR brings back characters like Martine Burden, Brian Dutton, Edward & Elinor Knox and others. Time to discover who is The 7th guest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192446/88996119253f9b1fe7f96b1e61c886506234c3ea.jpg[/img]

[h3]Expertly-crafted VR Puzzle Gameplay:[/h3]

All-new handcrafted puzzles, carefully redesigned for VR. All puzzles are meaningful to the story and rooted in lore with recognizable aesthetic elements paying homage to the original.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192446/af1cbb03ee0aa601a28fa537e06f8b149cdcb7e5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dynamic VR Environments:[/h3]

The equally beloved and feared haunted mansion comes alive around you through high-end visuals and VR-powered optical illusions, along with an all new adaptive soundtrack, inspired by the original and positional audio.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44192446/e0fe713aaf3d0b0e8a8ed98d50f3dd06aa201e58.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes for version 1.078!
notes.content:
Ahoy! We've just rolled out an update for Another Fisherman's Tale to tackle some reported bugs and implemented feedback. Thank you for taking the time to share this with us and for your patience! Please check the patch notes below!

[list]
[*] The subtitles checkbox is now available in the pause menu (previously only in Main Menu settings)
[*] Subtitle position change is correctly updated with a preview
[*] Changed the size of the saving text in loading screens and switched from 1" to 3" minimum time
[*] 'Hints' checkbox is deactivated by default for all platforms now
[/list]

[h2]Visual Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mirror issue has been fixed (no more reflection after body is reconstituted now)
[*] Submarine ride: Fixed visual glitch with rope appearing above the neck when seated in the submarine
[*] During epilogue: Fixed fade to black transition duration between an event
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Chapter 1] Fixed hand respawn during tutorial for both hands. After exchanging the hand with crab new respawn spot is one the trunk of palm tree. The hand previously respawned elsewhere.
[*] Fixed missing "eating the Donut" interaction (it disappears with a crunching sound when it is close to the mouth of the player)
[*] [Chapter 2] Removed the detaching of spare Bob head after having opened the door of the boat to avoid confusion with some users thinking it was useful later on.
[/list]

Thank you for your time, and thank you for playing!
-InnerSpaceVR

notes.title: Let's set sail on a new adventure!
notes.content:
Ahoy! We're so excited to see you here and sincerely hope you're just as excited as we are to continue the story of Bob the Fisherman in "Another Fisherman's Tale"!

[previewyoutube=vmVnFmYZO2g;full][/previewyoutube]

In this new upcoming adventure, we step into the shoes of Nina, the daughter of the original game’s protagonist, as she discovers models, notes and photographs that document her father’s mysterious past, as well as her own childhood.

[h3]Wishlist now![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096570/Another_Fishermans_Tale/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682204/eeb98a78dbf3bff9297bf157e42e320376742381.png[/img]

Featuring a total reinvention of its predecessor’s mechanics, Another Fisherman’s Tale imagines a world where YOU are the puzzle:

[b]DETACH[/b] limbs and hands from your body and physically control them remotely. Throw Bob’s hand across a ravine and then make it crawl to retrieve an object, or send your head elsewhere for a different view of things.

[b]REPLACE [/b]any of your limbs with a variety of objects to unlock new skills. Pirate hook hands allow you to climb up walls, a crab’s claw can cut through a rope in a pinch, and a fish’s tail will improve your swimming ability.

[b]CONTROL [/b]your environment with your puppeteering hands, picking up distant objects, items and tools and interacting with each level’s unique layout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682204/fddf9054e88c19c8283509636426ad29de1181dc.png[/img]

🎣 [url=https://anotherfishermanstale-vr.com/]Visit the website[/url]
🎣 [url=https://vertigo-games.com/another-fishermans-tale-reveal/]Read the full announcement[/url]


We can't wait for you to come back to this world in a new mind-bending story!
